Scrap ([[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]) is the currency and base resource used in FTL universe. 

Outside of stores and events scrap can be used to upgrade installed [[systems]] and increase the [[reactor]] power of a [[ship]]. 

In stores scrap can be spent on new [[systems]], [[weapons]], [[Drones|drone schematics]], [[augmentations]], [[Crew Members|crewmembers]], as well as to purchase resources - [[fuel]], [[missiles]], [[drone parts]] - and [[Ship#Hull|hull]] repairs. In stores, however, scrap can also be gained - by selling weapons, drone schematics and augmentations, albeit at half-price (rounded down against player).

Throughout the game a player will come across numerous [[:Category:Trading Events|trading events]] which allow using scrap to gain a weapon, drone schematic, augmentation, crewmembers, or upgrade systems and ship reactor, or exchanged for resources. However, some trading events allow trading one type of resource for another or to exchange a resource to gain items or other benefits without using scrap. In certain [[:Category:Scrap use Events|events]] scrap can be specifically used to gain various benefits or avoid dangers.

The actual amount of scrap received by defeating ships, killing enemy crew, or as reward in different events depends on the Scrap Sector parameter <ref name="Calculated FTL. Scrap sectors.">[https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2127539536 Calculated FTL. Scrap sectors.]</ref>. The game difficulty setting - chosen on the ship selection screen before a game run - affects this parameter so that more scrap is rewarded in all sectors for easier difficulty settings. The actual scrap reward values, depending on the sector number and the game difficulty, can be seen in the tables here: [https://mikehopley.github.io/ftl-scrap/easy Easy], [https://mikehopley.github.io/ftl-scrap/normal Normal], [https://mikehopley.github.io/ftl-scrap/ Hard].

The sector type can affect the scrap gains as well - that depends on the events which can possibly occur in a particular sector type (e.g. double rewards events), but not in another sector type.<ref name="Sector profit data.">[https://www.reddit.com/r/ftlgame/comments/bwk4ot/sector_profit_data_from_200x_sector_4_hard/ Sector profit data.]</ref>

One of the ship achievements for the Lanius Cruiser is called [[Scrap Hoarder]] and requires a player to have at least 600 unspent scrap in the storage.
